**An asymptotic formula of the divergent bilateral basic hypergeometric series Takeshi MORITA∗**

12 pp, 4 sections.

**Abstract.** We show an asymptotic formula of the divergent bilateral bas ic hypergeometric series 1ψ 0(a; −;q, ·) with using the q-Borel-Laplace method. We also give the limit q → 1 − 0 of our asymptotic formula.

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 2 Basic notations; 3.1 Local solutions of the degenerated equatio; 3.2 An asymptotic formula
